title: 10.5 Angle Relationships in Circles

icans: I can find the angle formed by a tangent and a chord.
I can find angles formed by lines that meet inside or outside a circle.
I can find the measure of a circumscribed angle.

vocab: an angle whose sides are __________ to a circle
a line that _____________ a circle in two points
a line in the plane of a circle that _____________ the circle in exactly one point

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: vertex inside the circle

blocks.p: Draw a circle with center O and two chords that cross inside it. Measure one angle where they cross, and the two arcs that angle and its vertical angle open onto.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Tangent and Intersected Chord Theorem: the angle formed by a tangent and a chord at the point of tangency is _______________ its intercepted arc.

blocks.stem:
Line BC is tangent to the circle at B.
a.  Find m∠ABC.
b.  If the angle formed by a tangent and a chord is 104°, what is its intercepted arc?

notes: Angles Inside the Circle Theorem: when two chords cross inside a circle, each angle is one-half the _______________ of the arcs intercepted by the angle and its vertical angle.

blocks.stem: Two chords cross inside the circle. Find the value of x.

notes: Angles Outside the Circle Theorem: when tangents or secants meet outside a circle, the angle is one-half the _______________ of the intercepted arcs (far arc minus near arc).

blocks.stem: Two secants meet at P outside the circle. Find the value of x.

notes: Circumscribed Angle Theorem: a circumscribed angle measures 180° minus the _______________ angle that intercepts the same arc.

blocks.stem: P̅A̅ and P̅B̅ are tangent to circle O. Find m∠APB.
From a satellite, the two lines of sight to the horizon are tangent to Earth. The arc of Earth you can see measures 166°. What is the angle between the lines of sight?
Two chords cross inside a circle. The arcs intercepted by an angle and its vertical angle measure 84° and 116°. Find the angle.
A tangent and a secant meet outside a circle. The far arc measures 160° and the near arc measures 50°. Find the angle.

tickets.stem: A tangent and a chord meet at the point of tangency. The intercepted arc measures 98°. Find the angle.
Two chords cross inside a circle. The intercepted arcs measure 40° and 90°. Find the angle.
Two secants meet outside a circle. The intercepted arcs measure 130° and 30°. Find the angle.
